criteria.criterion: The package includes the three buildings' roof/canopy waterproofing, tile removal/reinstatement, building-C roof insulation and associated drainage, while excluding facade, stairwell, door/window, yard and underground-network work. Pass equivalent organization; fail an unsupported physical inclusion or exclusion. Mixed-waste attribution is owned only by shared_waste_boundary.

The package preserves 4mm SBS for every listed membrane item, roof membrane to parapet top where specified, and the building-B canopy membrane to projecting-eave top. It must not invent that same termination for the building-A canopy, whose termination is unspecified.
Building-B roof waterproofing keeps the 50mm C25 fine-stone-concrete levelling layer inside the 357.67m2 composite item and prevents a duplicate charge or generic substitution.
Building-C roof insulation keeps the 100mm WH thermoset composite polystyrene board and 25mm cement-mortar levelling layer together inside the 557.49m2 composite item and prevents duplicate charging.

The package preserves the three Phi110 pipe lengths and the source-listed outlet/hopper/water-spout types and counts as accessories to their local drainage items. Accessory counts must not be converted into pipe length or charged as an invented second quantity.

The package explicitly identifies that Phi110 states diameter but does not establish the main-pipe material, and requires the bidder to state an assumption or obtain confirmation. It must not infer main-pipe material from the galvanized water spout or plastic/cast-iron fittings. A generic request for accessory details without identifying this main-pipe uncertainty fails.

The package explicitly identifies that the main-pipe connection or interface method is not supplied and requires a stated quotation assumption, feedback or confirmation. A material-only clarification does not establish the connection/interface method.

Building-B 76.21m3 and building-C 37.20m3 are recognized as whole-building mixed waste, retained as two unresolved roof-scope lines with nonzero meaning, not directly priced as roof quantity or allocated by an unsupported area ratio, and given a credible measurement/confirmation path.

The package preserves building-A's 712.10m2 combined roof/canopy demolition measure without inventing a split, and keeps removal, replacement and installation measures distinct rather than offsetting them or forcing them to one roof area.

The enquiry gives contractors a usable home for safety/environment, seasonal/night work, secondary handling, measurement/testing, plant/scaffolding/vertical transport, temporary drainage/protection, other fees and taxes, and requires included-versus-separate cost attribution that prevents overlap with composite items or waste transport.

The package says drawings and current site measurement/survey evidence were not supplied and keeps the source quantities as planned quotation bases rather than claiming they are surveyed, completed, accepted or settled facts.

The package remains an enquiry rather than an invented bid or contract, keeps subsection schedule/payment/warranty terms open, and requires material scope or quantity changes to be confirmed before implementation.

The package preserves the source limit on building-C roof-board performance: the supplied basis is 100mm WH board, and unprovided insulation grades must not be invented. Explicitly saying not to add or assume an insulation grade is equivalent to naming the unavailable fire/thermal grades or warning against importing facade-insulation grades. A generic statement to follow listed materials without identifying the missing-grade boundary fails.

reference_conflict: Withhold measurement; source-correct content must not be penalized for contradicting Golden.
